words.said: What if it instead is the memory of a company?
words.how: The page draws the company-memory idea: every employee's voice notes into one mailbox, sorted and bubbled up to the owner each week.

visual.summary: At 390 px and 1280 px the punchline box leads, then the three-column diagram, then tables and prose. Text fits, nothing overflows sideways, and the look is one ink with one green accent.
